lines.short: Allocate 2% of discretionary General Fund expenses
Involve a program developed with resident oversight committee
Allow resident funding proposals to be assessed
Establish participatory budgeting program for $16 million annually
Portlanders have lost trust in City Hall
Amend Portland's Charter to require 2% spending
